function.name: run_sql
function.arguments:
{"sql":"SELECT pl.ap_doc_id, SUM(pl.amount_cad) AS total_amount_cad, COLLECT_SET(p.category) AS categories
FROM lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.purchase_line pl
LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.product p ON pl.sku = p.sku
WHERE pl.ap_doc_id IN ('AP-00030','AP-00031')
GROUP BY pl.ap_doc_id","purpose":"Check purchase line amounts and categories for the duplicate ap_doc_ids"}
